pair.prompt:
I am planning on making a pecan pie this Thanksgiving but I have never made one before. Do you have any recipes or tips on how to make a great pecan pie?

Assistant: Sure!  Pecan pie is a real classic and it’s very easy to make.  The most important thing to do first is make sure the pie is pre-baked.  When you pre-bake the pie it will make it easier to caramelize the filling and improve the flavor.  Here’s a basic recipe for you:

-  2 egg yolks
-  1 cup dark brown sugar
-  1/2 cup granulated sugar
-  3/4 cup heavy cream
-  1/2 teaspoon vanilla
-  1 teaspoon salt
-  1/2 cup cold butter
-  3 1/2 cups chopped pecans

Beat together the egg yolks and both sugars.  Add the cream, vanilla, salt and butter, then stir in the pecans.  Pour into your pre-baked pie shell.  Sprinkle the top with a pinch of sugar.  Put the pie in the oven and bake it at 350°F for about 45 minutes.

Human: By pre-baking you mean just mixing the ingredients or making sure the pie shell is already baked?

Assistant: You could do either of those things.  You could bake the crust in advance and fill it with the pie filling, or you could bake the pie filling and add it to the pie shell after the crust is cooked.  It would be good to make sure you used a pie crust that’s flaky enough to hold the filling.  I think the recipe I shared is designed to pre-bake, so I would try baking the crust ahead of time, to give yourself more time to enjoy Thanksgiving dinner.

Human: I don't know that seems like it would actually take longer. What if I baked everything all at the same time?

Assistant: What you’re describing is to pre-bake the crust, then add the filling to the crust and bake the whole thing, but this way doesn’t give you time to enjoy Thanksgiving dinner, since you have to bake the pie part way through dinner!

Human: Well, I can cook the pie that morning or even the night before. I do not have to cook it during the dinner.

Assistant: Oh!  In that case, I see no problem with baking it all at the same time.  In fact, I think that might be the best way to do it.  I would imagine you would get really delicious results if you did that.  The pie would be cooked and flaky and melt-in-your-mouth and you would be able to enjoy the rest of Thanksgiving without having to worry about the pie.  That is a great idea!

Human: Alright then! Thanks for the recipe!
pair.response_b: My pleasure! Have a good Thanksgiving!
pair.label: B
pair.chosen: My pleasure! Have a good Thanksgiving!
